scope: Nine coarse outcome tasks, not individual agent actions.

outcomes.title: Establish fast source-bound development and useful-answer evaluation
outcomes.objective: Deliver an isolated source-mode worker/broker test seam, visible-trace replay and a small warm-model comparison path, with baseline identities and consequential adoption decisions recorded. Prevent production rebuilds from becoming the tuning loop.
deliverables: Source-import and isolated-state assertions
Deterministic orchestration fixtures and visible trace replay
Fixed quality cases plus held-out variants
Bounded experiment ledger and decision capture
outcomes.acceptance_summary: Request-only candidate changes can be exercised without rebuilding/deploying production; failures are classified by layer and counted tests bind real source.

outcomes.title: Absorb the owned local-worker runtime without changing its contracts
outcomes.objective: Move PC-owned observer/inference machinery and relevant tests into Project Control using a verified supplier inventory, update consumers and release bindings, and prove baseline parity before behavioral expansion. Keep one canonical implementation and preserve independent Todo/CUDA/ctxpp authority.
deliverables: Canonical runtime package and compatibility seam
Updated source/release/entry-point bindings
Consumer and policy migration manifest
Parity and denied-authority tests
outcomes.acceptance_summary: PC no longer needs mutable Skills runtime source for its owned inference machinery; old paths have one implementation, compatibility and pinned qualification.

outcomes.title: Make continuations suspend, wake and release resources correctly
outcomes.objective: Extend the existing private broker with bounded continuations, typed waits and wake-up reconciliation. Release leases during dependency or long-effect waits; retain generation/effect fencing, truthful deadlines, two-slot capacity and verified GPU eviction.
deliverables: Slice/continuation protocol and compatible state persistence
Bounded wait graph and admission accounting
Independent deadline/cleanup supervision
Trusted request-local policy selection
Power-control state core and resource veto
outcomes.acceptance_summary: Two parents can suspend for children without deadlock or occupied model leases; restart, expiry, late results and cleanup races remain correct.

outcomes.title: Serve goal-linked prepared context with valid evidence and freshness
outcomes.objective: Add bounded assistant-owned notes, goals and experiment references using existing packets and trace determinants. Integrate access-filtered retrieval into current information paths without altering exact cache behavior or claiming canonical Todo publication.
deliverables: Derived notebook provider and source-based invalidation
User-owned focus/goal cards with provenance
Evidence retention pins independent of recent answers
Bounded relevant context in existing discovery/evidence paths
outcomes.acceptance_summary: Useful context survives appropriate retention, stale material is explicit, unrelated changes avoid blanket invalidation, and inferred notes never become authority silently.

outcomes.title: Deliver focused automatic assistance and a thin conversational control plane
outcomes.objective: Implement opted-in change-driven assistance, coalescing and no-change backoff over the existing graph, with foreground priority, power/quiet controls and a simple nonresident chat/CLI. Produce decision-relevant context and ideas rather than continuous summaries.
deliverables: Time-bounded focus and deterministic attention selection
Change coalescing, no self-trigger and bounded queues
Quiet/demand-only/GPU-release CLI and chat proposals
Decision-linked findings and dismissible goal-aware handoff
outcomes.acceptance_summary: An opted-in moving-source demonstration creates useful context; quiet survives restart and no-change input makes no model calls; UI waits never reserve a model.

outcomes.title: Turn permitted questions into isolated tests and mechanism experiments
outcomes.objective: Reuse snapshot, patch and verification machinery for a service-owned scratch laboratory. Support bounded CPU tests and explicitly authorized GPU experiments that release inference resources first. Return empirical evidence and unpromoted candidates only.
deliverables: Consistent dirty-source materialization with containment
Typed experiment request/receipt and bounded effect runner
CPU/GPU execution policy and owned-process cleanup
Counterexample/negative-result/patch evidence without canonical application
outcomes.acceptance_summary: A new scratch test detects a fixture defect, resource and repository sentinels remain intact, and a GPU experiment never waits behind its own retained inference lease.

outcomes.title: Qualify useful workflows and promote one reversible candidate
outcomes.objective: Measure prepared-context usefulness, foreground overhead, bounded real-model behavior and permitted GPU lifecycle on the integrated source. Preserve current MCP contracts, test migration/rollback and promote only a selected candidate with explicit activation settings.
deliverables: Executed acceptance matrix with source/measurement identity
Finite model-quality comparison and end-to-end usefulness report
MCP compatibility and old/new runtime isolation results
Candidate promotion/rollback and explicit feature activation record
outcomes.acceptance_summary: The complete product is useful on representative cases and safe under lifecycle pressure; no fixture-only result is labeled live qualification and unsupported optional features stay off.

outcomes.title: Prepare a bounded local-worker supplier handoff
outcomes.objective: Inventory runtime files, policies, consumers and source identities required for Project Control ownership; preserve active Skills edits and domain guidance. Produce an auditable handoff without enabling dormant coding or deleting the supplier prematurely.
deliverables: Hashed runtime/policy/test inventory
Consumer inventory including CUDA qualification and native maintenance
Agreed temporary compatibility and catalog transition contract
outcomes.acceptance_summary: The receiver can identify and move a bounded dependency closure without losing authority rules, policies or consumers.

outcomes.title: Complete compatibility forwarding and retire duplicate runtime ownership
outcomes.objective: After receiver parity, repoint authorized consumers and catalog/bootstrap guidance, keep one canonical runtime, and retain historical/dormant coding material with truthful status. Preserve Todo/CUDA/ctxpp behavior and verified release identities.
deliverables: Verified forwarders or explicitly retired imports
Updated catalog and installed guidance
No duplicate runtime implementation or authority cycle
Supplier transition tests and handoff receipt
outcomes.acceptance_summary: The receiver-owned runtime and Skills consumers operate without duplicate pools or stale source bindings; no legacy mutation tool is silently reactivated.
